decisive_items: Figure 1 Title: Squamous cell carcinoma from a mediastinal mass
Contrast CT chest: showed lobar and segmental pulmonary emboli in right middle and lower lobes
response.rationale: The mediastinal mass biopsy with P40 positivity and explicit figure title directly establish squamous cell carcinoma as the primary diagnosis. Pulmonary embolism is a secondary finding, while CKD and anemia are nonspecific lab abnormalities.

rejected.why: Pulmonary embolism is a complication of the mediastinal mass, not the primary diagnosis.
Elevated creatinine reflects renal impairment but is not the most likely unifying diagnosis.
Low hemoglobin is a nonspecific finding and not the primary diagnosis.
